stem:
Hema must order notebooks for $33$ students when notebooks are sold only in packs of $5$. She also keeps a separate inventory tally that must record the exact student count.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims fit these needs?

options.text: Call both answers "approximate value" only, without choosing exact, round-up, round-down, or nearest-place for each need.
Order $35$ notebooks (round up in packs of $5$ so every student has one).
Keep $33$ exact in the inventory tally.
Say that writing a rounded notebook order is what creates the exact tally of $33$.

teacher.key_rationale: Packs of 5 force a round-up order to 35; the inventory tally must stay exactly 33. Labelling both as approximate value only swaps the decision for a term. Saying the rounded order creates the exact tally reverses the relation.
